------------------------------------------------------------------------

Script: **02_clean.R** \#

**Purpose**: Combine per-sheet TSV files, clean and tidy the data, and derive key variables for analysis.

**Why**: We want a single, tidy table that is easy to use \# in downstream analyses and visualisations. \# Input: TSV files in data/sheets_tsv/ (one per sheet) \# Output: 02_data_clean.tsv (clean, combined dataset)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Read data/01_dat_load.tsv
# Clean and convert to tidy format
# Save as data/02_dat_clean.tsv
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

```{r}
source("99_proj_func.R")
```

Create a combined tsv

```{r}
#| warning: false

file_path <- here("data", "sheets_tsv")

patients <- list.files(
  path = file_path)



#define correct interpretation of column which raised error
col_spec <- cols(
    `-log10(masked_p)` = col_double()
)


#vertically stacking as each patient has same cols
combined_data <- patients |>
  map_dfr(
    load_tsvData,
    folder = file_path,
    col_types = col_spec,
    na = c("NA", "N/A", "---")
  )

combined_data
```

Extract PE+ Population = Multimer Frequency

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data |>
  group_by(sample)|>
  rename(freq= ...33)|>
  mutate(
    MultimerFrequency = sum(replace_na(freq, 0))
  )|>
  ungroup()


combined_data
```

Drop last row per patient

```{r}
 combined_data <- combined_data |>
  drop_na(barcode)
 
 combined_data
```

Keep only important columns

```{r}
subset_data <-combined_data |>
  select(
    c("sample", 
      "count.1", 
      "input.1", 
      "input.2", 
      "input.3", 
      "log_fold_change", 
      "p", 
      "HLA", 
      "Protein", 
      "Peptide",
      "MultimerFrequency")
  )

subset_data
```

Extract patient number

```{r}
combined_data_new <- subset_data |>
  mutate(
    sampleID = str_remove(sample, "_.*$"),
    sampleID = str_sub(sampleID, start = 3, end = 4))|>
  relocate(sampleID)


combined_data_new
```

Clean HLA

```{r}
combined_data_new <- combined_data_new |>
  mutate(
    HLA = str_remove(HLA, "HLA-")
  )
```

Extract gene

```{r}
combined_data_new <- combined_data_new |>
  separate_wider_delim(Protein, "_", names= c("genome", "weird1", "Protein", "extra"), too_few ="align_start" )|>
  select(-weird1, -extra, -genome)

combined_data_new

```

Save cleaned data as tsv

```{r}

save_tsvData(combined_data_new, "02_data_clean.tsv")
```
